extraction_notes: Identity: TDSEMIC (tdsemic.com) 'SOT-23 Plastic-Encapsulate Transistors', device MMBT2907 2F, explicitly labeled TRANSISTOR (PNP) with 'MARKING:2F' on datasheet Page 1; complementary to MMBT2222. SOT-23 pinout: 1 = BASE, 2 = EMITTER, 3 = COLLECTOR. The requested MPN 'MMBT2907 2F' matches the datasheet header and the 2F marking identity exactly.
The PDF is image-only (no text layer); all values were transcribed visually from 200-400 dpi page renders.

Electrical characteristics (Tamb = 25 degC) were transcribed with the datasheet's negative PNP sign convention preserved; guaranteed MIN/MAX bounds are recorded as source_kind minimum/maximum and were never converted to typicals. Currents and voltages in specs are converted to SI base units (A, V, Hz).

hFE is specified only at a single operating point (VCE = -10 V, IC = -150 mA) as a 100 (min) to 400 (max) span; no typical value is published. The 'CLASSIFICATION OF hFE' table lists two range bins, 100-300 and 300-400, with no bin-to-marking-suffix mapping printed.

The two Typical Characteristics figures plot negative axis values (PNP); curve points are recorded as magnitudes with the original datasheet axis units (mA, V, MHz) and the sign convention noted per curve. Points are digitized visually from log-axis figures and carry roughly 5-10 percent reading uncertainty.
ft spec is taken from the typical curve (no tabulated fT row): approximately 325 MHz near the curve peak at |IC| = 50 mA, VCE = -20 V; the curve peaks at about 330 MHz around |IC| = 30-40 mA.
cobo and cibo are null: the datasheet publishes no junction-capacitance values or capacitance-versus-voltage figures.

vceo is taken from the guaranteed V(BR)CEO minimum (-60 V at IC = -1 mA, IB = 0); the absolute maximum ratings table consistently lists VCEO = 60 V (magnitude). Other maximum ratings for reference only: VCBO 60 V, VEBO 5 V, IC 0.6 A continuous, PC 0.225 W, Tj 150 degC, Tstg -55 to 150 degC.
Cut-off currents (not schema fields, for reference): ICBO max -1 uA at VCB = -50 V, ICEO max -10 uA at VCE = -30 V, IEBO max -1 uA at VEB = -5 V.
Extraction used only the supplied public TDSEMIC datasheet PDF; no vendor SPICE models or third-party sources were consulted.
